decisive_spans.text: Granular and linear deposition of IgG and C3 at the basement membrane zone and abundant intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 in the upper two-thirds of the epidermis

response.rationale: The direct immunofluorescence findings of granular and linear deposition of IgG and C3 at the basement membrane zone are highly characteristic of Lupus erythematosus and are not typically seen in Pemphigus. While Pemphigus also shows intercellular deposition of IgG and C3, the basement membrane zone involvement points strongly to Lupus erythematosus.
